summary.headline: Astrological Judgments, Folios 76–83
summary.text: Catalog of astrological questions and judgments from folios 76–83, covering planetary conjunctions, royal births, travel, rain, rebellion, fortune, adversaries, the lot of fortune, and the effects of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Moon, and Mercury. It also discusses the religion of the Saracens, prophets, the Greeks, and signs associated with truth-telling, learning, eloquence, and poetry.
